data.gender_notes: Sawyer is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘sigeweorca’ meaning ‘victorious worker’ or ‘worker of the highest significance’. The name Sawyer was given to those who worked with wood, particularly those who cut timber or made saws. The name Sawyer carries the meaning “Worker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sawyer usually hope their child will grow to embody worker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embraces the spiritual qualities of hard work, dedication, and craftsmanship.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sawyer total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
